definitions.explanation: Describes an older style, model, or method that has been superseded by newer ones. Often used for machines and equipment, and frequently with の before a noun.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧式|きゅうしき}だ。
examples.english: This machine is an old model.

examples.japanese: {旧式|きゅうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{旧式|きゅうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかり→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧すぎる。
examples.english: The old-fashioned method takes too much time.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old, former) + {式|しき} (style, type). It describes a model, design, or method from an earlier generation, now considered outdated. Frequently used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun ({旧式|きゅうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧式|きゅうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧: an old-model machine
- {旧式|きゅうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧: an old-fashioned method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新式|しんしき}→新式：28151_shinshiki⟧: new-style, new model — the opposite, a newer design or method
